question: \(AB\) is a diameter of \(\odot O\), and point \(C\) lies on the circle. Given \(\angle CAB=30^\circ\) and \(BC=3\), find the radius of \(\odot O\).
solution: \(\angle ACB=90^\circ\) and \(\angle A=30^\circ\), so \(AB=2BC=6\). The radius is \(3\).
